title: Define and prototype animated geometry binding
description:
Source: docs/tasks/tickets/CC-073-animated-geometry-binding-contract.md
Source key: CC-073
Source status: Backlog
Source priority: P1

## Summary

Define how generated geometry follows the semantic skeleton. The current
`CreatureRig` moves bones only. Generated implicit geometry has no weights, and
mesh-asset geometry is still a baked static presentation mesh.

## Scope

- Record the binding contract before adding a renderer.
- Prototype one two-segment limb with rest-space vertices, bind poses, and
  deterministic weights.
- Prove rest-pose round trip, pose movement, mirrored behavior, and return to rest.
- Use rigid attachment for mesh-asset items only when their semantic bone mapping
  is explicit. Keep the welded Body surface separate until its weighting model is
  validated.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Binding does not make generated meshes authoritative over DNA or morphology.
- Rest-space skinning reproduces the generated rest geometry within tolerance.
- Reapplying the rest pose restores the original vertices deterministically.
- A posed limb visibly moves through a `SkinnedMeshRenderer` or a documented
  equivalent deformation path.

## Validation

Unity Play Mode and focused runtime tests must validate bind poses, weights,
mirrored limbs, and posed vertex positions. Static compilation alone cannot close
this ticket.

## Findings

The audit recommends testing semantic and parametric limb weights before Body
weights. Nearest-bone Euclidean distance is not sufficient for bent chains.
`GeneratedCreature` should remain a generation result, not an animation state
container.

## Blockers

The resolved morphology layer and canonical attachment contract are not complete.
Unity runtime execution is also required for renderer behavior.

## Next Step

Finish shared configuration validation, then design the two-segment limb binding
fixture and its bind-pose invariant.

## 2026-08-24 audit revision (11:48 delta audit) - defer until bone resolution shared
Exact mesh binding is premature until semantic bone resolution is a shared
service (CC-076). Do not implement `GeometryItem -> ParentPartId ->
nearest/parent bone -> attach renderer` independently in the geometry system.
Skeleton construction, mesh binding, and animation queries must consume the same
`SemanticBoneResolver`. Resolved morphology (CC-056A/B) is the prerequisite for
both.

comments.body: Orchestrator Round 2 evidence (2026-09-05, three-round sequential-subagent handoff, C4.1-C4.4): binding contract written first and recorded in the owning runtime module, then a two-segment fixture proved. New: Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/Binding/LinearBlendSkinning.cs (pure-math LBS deformation path, the documented equivalent to SkinnedMeshRenderer satisfying CC-073 acceptance) + contract constants, and Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/LinearBlendSkinningTests.cs. Contract conventions recorded: rest-space (vertices in creature-space rest; bind offsets from rest frame; GeneratedCreature stays pose-free); bone-index (index into order fixed by SkeletonSnapshot capture via existing semantic resolution; never part->bone/nearest-bone/mesh-name/Unity order); bind-pose (bind==rest, scale-free frames => quaternion-inverse bind offset, exact); weight (non-negative, authored sum 1, MaxBoneInfluencesPerVertex=4, Deform normalizes defensively, zero/negative/non-finite weight throws DomainException); mirror (flows through existing MirrorUtility ReflectPointAcrossX + MirrorAcrossXPlane rotation conjugation; same weights; no mirror-identity rediscovery); ownership (consumer of resolved anatomy; holds no skeleton/DNA/GeneratedCreature/pose state; welded Body surface out of scope). Rest-pose invariant uses RestRoundTripTolerance=1e-3f. Fixture bone0->bone1->terminal along +X; explicit rest vertices A/D/B/C/T and weights; bend = bone1 +90deg about Z; expected posed vertices hand-computed and asserted (e.g. blended D = 0.88,-0.08,0, terminal T -> (1,1,0)). 13 tests: rest round trip, rotated-rest round trip, posed bend to explicit expected + real-movement guard, reapply-rest deterministic restore, pure translation, unnormalized-weight normalization, mirrored-config equals reflection of unmirrored result (algebraic commutation via MirrorUtility), mirrored rest round trip, and 5 DomainException validation cases. Validation (real Unity via MCP): dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore 0/0; ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime 0/0; Unity focused PlayMode LinearBlendSkinningTests 13/13; full ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime PlayMode 489/489 (0 failed/skipped); git diff --check clean. Status moved Backlog->InProgress. Remaining TSK-0077 scope (deferred, not done): C4.5 full mirrored-morphology numeric proof over a whole CreatureDefinition, and C5 route GeometryItem.RigBinding -> resolved source part -> semantic bone -> indexed bone. Renderer/welded-Body weighting still out of scope. No Data/Tasks edited by hand; orchestrator committing this slice.

comments.body: Audit synthesis 2026-09-06 (SkinnedMeshRenderer animation-MVP audits; council-reviewed): TSK-0077 stays InProgress as the geometry-binding owner. The C4.5 mirror proof is closed on the synthetic fixture. The remaining distance to the real MVP is real-geometry weighting + SkinnedMeshRenderer wiring, now filed as children under this owner: TSK-0130 (rigid mesh-asset bind weights, de-risking), TSK-0131 (deterministic implicit welded-surface weights, MVP-critical), TSK-0132 (runtime SkinnedMeshRenderer adapter), TSK-0134 (per-frame perf budget). 0133 (external-driver decision) sits under TSK-0073. Council disposition: tighten this task's acceptance from "SkinnedMeshRenderer OR documented equivalent" to a live SMR-parity-with-LBS-oracle gate on real generated geometry, delivered by child TSK-0132; do NOT close on the LBS-only branch because the user MVP requires a real SkinnedMeshRenderer. Source-verified: implicit surface is one welded mesh (body+limbs), so TSK-0131 is not optional for idle/walk. Keep GeneratedCreature pose-free; binding/weights are build-time pure data.
